visualBrief: Hwaseong Fortress at Suwon. Four individually oriented gates, the seven arches of Hwahongmun, two distinct Gongsimdon watchtowers, five rampart reaches and the historic command pavilions.

photoFacing.frontBasis: The four mapped gate platforms and named guard buildings are fitted separately. Model +X points east and +Z points south. The watergate deck follows the PMTiles footway over Suwoncheon.

terrain: Bilinear eight-meter sampling from standard zoom-15 Terrarium tiles.
limitations: The model covers the four main gates, the north watergate, the named command posts and watchtowers, and five rampart reaches fitted beside mapped walking routes.
The model leaves present-day gaps by Paldalmun open. Unmodeled ramparts, the southern watergate and Hwaseong Haenggung use the surrounding map.
Stonework, gates and timber ornament are reconstructed from photographs. Standard Terrarium gives the grade but smooths the riverbank and the exposed rampart toes.
